themes.summary: Houthis claimed strikes on Aramco sites in Dhahran and Riyadh and vowed more; US crude futures hit three-week highs on fresh attacks.
IEA cut 2027 demand to 104.4 million b/d from 105 million b/d, sees 2026 demand falling 2.6 million b/d, with recovery not before March 2027.
Middle East and Russia gasoil exports fell more than 60% y/y in September and OECD gasoil stocks are the lowest since November 2023.
Gulf crude exports rose 4.4 million b/d to 13.9 million b/d in September and Hormuz flows to 10.9 million b/d, but IEA says recovery remains vulnerable to renewed attacks.

themes.theme: Russia refining recovery and US talks
themes.summary: Novak says plants are restarting and output will rise, a US waiver and partial export-ban lift were issued, yet about 45% of primary refining capacity was offline at end-September.
IEA countries released 331 of 400 million barrels committed; about 96 million barrels remain, mostly over the next four months.
Nigeria met its OPEC quota for a fifth month at 1.53 million b/d and Venezuela output edged up to 1.218 million b/d in September.
